These small fixtures contain a generated 440 Hz sine wave, encoded as 24-bit
PCM WAV, MP3, FLAC, and Vorbis. The compressed files have the title “Native
fixture” and artist “Chill”. They are committed so native playback tests require
neither FFmpeg nor network access.

`tone-48000.ogg` contains an 880 Hz sine wave at 48 kHz with title “Second song”
and artist “Chill”, for chained streams with changing sample rates and tags.
